text:
Kira Patel: Heads-up: we're opening SDK 5.0-alpha to internal users today. Main changes: stricter request validation (params must be snake_case), rename `response_mode` -> `output_mode`, and a new opt-in `strict_schema=true`. This could be breaking for some integrations. PR: https://git.redwood/example/sdk-5-alpha
Samir Nair: Oof. How many internal callers do we expect to break? Any quick estimate?
Kira Patel: Early scan shows ~12 services failing unit tests if they flip strict_schema. Most will be fine if they keep strict_schema=false. We're encouraging a migration path over 120 days before we flip the default in a minor release.
Olivia Park: Can we make the validation opt-in with a clear warning log so teams can test without risk?
Kira Patel: Yes  default for alpha/beta is opt-in. We'll publish a feature flag `SDK_STRICT_SCHEMA=1` for CI. We'll also emit a deprecation header when we detect `response_mode` usage.
DocsBot: Preview docs: https://docs.redwood/preview/sdk-5-alpha. Includes migration guide and a compatibility table. New badge: `compat-tested` for client libraries that pass the schema suite.
Samir Nair: Rollout plan? Will this hit hosted customers?
Kira Patel: Timeline: alpha (internal) -> beta (select external partners) -> GA. We'll not change defaults for hosted API clients until after GA and a 120-day notice. For Dedicated/Private customers, nothing will change until they upgrade their SDKs.
Olivia Park: Please add sample diffs for the common SDK usage patterns. Example: ````python
# old
client.call(prompt, response_mode=\"chat\")
# new
client.call(prompt, output_mode=\"chat\")
# env test opt-in
export SDK_STRICT_SCHEMA=1
````
Samir Nair: Need Legal signoff on the 120-day window and banner language for customers. @LegalBot can you review the draft?
LegalBot: Received. Will review the deprecation wording by EOD tomorrow. Recommend explicit dates, rollback policy, and an opt-out clause for enterprise contracts.
Kira Patel: Also adding a small migration CI job `verify-sdk5-compat` in our examples repo that runs the schema suite and posts a badge. Olivia can you own the examples sync?
Olivia Park: I can. I'll add Node/Rust/Go snippets and a one-click GitHub Action.
DocsBot: Reminder: label preview issues with `sdk5-preview` and tag @Olivia Park for review.
Samir Nair: Let's communicate in the release notes the exact param mapping table and mention the fallback behavior (server accepts both for 120 days but logs a warning).
Kira Patel: Good call. We'll keep dual-accept for 120 days, then server will reject `response_mode` after GA. Posting a short customer-facing note becomes part of the GA checklist.
Olivia Park: Also, can we add a compatibility shim in the Node SDK to auto-map `response_mode` -> `output_mode` for one minor? That'll reduce churn.
Kira Patel: Yes, we're exploring a one-minor shim; will document in the migration guide if we ship it.
Samir Nair: Thanks. I'll start blocking my infra changes until beta completes. Ping this thread when legal and docs preview are green.
Kira Patel: Will do. Thanks folks.
